council: North York Moors National Park Authority
current_date: ECAB 2024 (form version shown on each page)
current_evidence: No separate local list was found on the forms page or by search. The authority's 'Standard Local Validation Requirements' are built into each application form pack linked from the forms-and-guidance page, and the householder pack is marked ECAB 2024.

issues.detail: Grokbot read only the forms-and-guidance hub page, not the local requirements. The authority's local validation requirements are a 'Standard Local Validation Requirements' checklist inside each form PDF (householder, full planning, listed building consent, etc.), and none of those were read.
issues.evidence: Hub page refers to 'the validation checklist' (Note 1) without a separate list; Householder-Planning-Application-Form.pdf contains 'Standard Local Validation Requirements'

issues.detail: The list date 2026-04-01 is the effective date of the planning fee schedule shown on the page. It is not the date of the page or of any validation list. The validation checklist in the form packs is marked ECAB 2024.
issues.evidence: 'Planning Application Fees (as of 01 April 2026)'; the page gives no updated date

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none)', but the householder pack lists five local requirements. (1) Bat Scoping Survey: barn conversions with the roof substantially intact, demolition of pre-WW1 houses or barns, works to bridges, kilns, caves or tunnels, wind turbines within 50 m of a building, woodland or linear feature, or evidence of bats. (2) Flood Risk Assessment / Sequential Test where flooding implications arise. (3) Tree Survey / Arboricultural Assessment to BS 5837:2012 where trees on or next to the site could affect or be affected by the development. (4) Structural Survey for conversion of traditional buildings. (5) Heritage Statement for works affecting a listed building, conservation area, registered park or garden, scheduled monument, or a non-designated heritage asset.
issues.evidence: Householder-Planning-Application-Form.pdf, 'Standard Local Validation Requirements' and Guidance Notes

issues.detail: Listed building consent, Outline, Advertisement and other types are all marked '(none)'. The authority publishes a form pack for each of these (e.g. Listed Building consent, advertisement consent, prior notification of demolition, agricultural prior notification), and these presumably carry the same local checklist. The Heritage Statement explicitly applies to Listed Building consent.
issues.evidence: Householder pack: Heritage Statement 'Required for Listed Building consent and for planning applications affecting a Listed Building...'

issues.detail: Both tab_items are page text, not requirements. One is a page heading run together with fee and guidance-note link text. The other is the process note telling applicants to disregard the number of copies on the checklist.
issues.evidence: 'Forms and guidance | NYMNP Application forms, fees and guidance Planning Application Fees...'; 'Please disregard the required number of copies...'

issues.detail: The triggers for BNG, Design and Access Statement and Heritage Statement are the same run of link text ('Design and Access Statement Guidance Note (pdf) Heritage Statement Guidance Note (pdf) Biodiversity Net Gain...'), so none of them says when the item applies. All three are also tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Heritage Statement applies to householder and listed building consent too, and the DAS trigger (major development or designated areas) is not stated.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt for the three Full planning rows

summary: Grokbot captured only the forms hub page and its fee date. It missed the 'Standard Local Validation Requirements' built into the authority's form packs (bat survey, FRA, tree survey, structural survey, heritage statement) and wrongly shows householder and other types as having no local requirements.
